nonclaims: Research records describe conventions and observable construction, not universal attraction or audience response.
A single frame does not prove prior relationships, consent, persistent personality, identity continuity, or temporal change unless its frame contract says it can.
Body shape, clothing, hair, accessories, and expressions do not establish health, age, gender, culture, diagnosis, or personality.
Prompt evidence is not rendered-pixel evidence.
This additive layer does not modify safety, refusal, retry, negative-prompt, or downstream policy behavior.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use before-and-after panels of the same character, preserving one same identity marker while a formerly intact allegiance emblem becomes a visibly corrupted emblem with a concrete consequence in the later panel
elements.limitation: A dark palette or hostile portrait alone cannot prove that the character was formerly good, why the change occurred, or that both states are the same person.
elements.design_inference: A paired frame is the smallest honest default because the trope depends on identity continuity plus state transition.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a three-panel relationship sequence: first show an established pair with a repeated bond token, then a third party entering, then the displaced partner witnessing the changed pair with an isolated reaction and visible consequence
elements.limitation: One intimate pair in one frame cannot establish a prior bond, non-consent, knowledge, infidelity, or the difference between netorare, netorase, netori, and BSS.
elements.design_inference: The runtime treats NTR as a typed three-party relationship viewpoint, never as ownership of a person.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Stage a split-level cross section with an awake calm subject above an occluding plane, explicit sensory suppression glyphs around the body, and a separate hidden event below the plane that the composition contrasts without claiming the magic is real
elements.limitation: A blindfold or neutral expression alone cannot prove loss of all senses, awareness, or a magical state.
elements.design_inference: A cross-section externalizes the information asymmetry while keeping the scientific source limited to multisensory perception.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use the reviewed backless knit minidress variant in a three-quarter rear view, showing a high halter neck attachment, sleeveless rib knit front continuity, an open back to the waist, and the mini dress hem; preserve the separate classical high-waist blouse-and-skirt variant as metadata rather than mixing both outfits
elements.limitation: The broad 2015 blouse-and-high-waist-skirt meme and the 2017 backless knit dress are related fan labels but different garment constructions.
elements.design_inference: The deterministic clause selects one construction so the image does not combine two incompatible garments; the sibling variant remains recorded in research metadata.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Show one provocateur directing a raised-chin sideways smirk and a small pointing gesture at one visible taunt target, with the target's concrete failed task and restrained reaction making the status provocation relational rather than a generic smug face
elements.limitation: Body size, a smug face, or a heart symbol alone cannot establish the slang, repeated speech style, or any later status reversal.
elements.design_inference: The clause compiles the relational provocation mechanism without copying a slur into visible text.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a full-body vertical standing split with exactly one support foot planted on the floor, one continuous free leg held nearly vertical beside the head, a visible same-side hand-to-ankle contact, and an anatomically continuous pelvis-to-leg chain
elements.limitation: One drawing cannot prove real flexibility, athletic ability, joint health, or a normative range of motion.
elements.design_inference: A frontal vertical full-body crop distinguishes this vernacular I silhouette from a diagonal Y-balance.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a matched before-and-after diptych: the first panel shows an oversized loose T-shirt, while the second shows one hand gripping excess fabric behind the back, converging tension folds, and the same shirt pulled close enough to reveal a changed silhouette without changing garments
evidence_groups_en: gripping excess fabric behind the back
elements.limitation: A single fitted-shirt frame cannot establish the challenge or the hidden-before versus revealed-after contrast.
elements.design_inference: A diptych is the smallest reliable contract for the same-garment transformation.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Construct a reverse bunny costume through coverage inversion: paired rabbit ears, a detached collar and bow tie, white wrist cuffs, long gloves or detached sleeves, and thigh-high legwear remain visible while the classic strapless torso suit is structurally absent rather than merely recolored
elements.limitation: The exact creator and first use are not independently established, and a shrug plus stockings without the bunny grammar is insufficient.
elements.design_inference: The element is modeled as a coverage relation, not as a standardized historical garment.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a context-and-reaction sequence with an establishing context panel, a foreground occluder forming clear T-junctions over the central action, and a separate reaction or consequence panel connected by one gaze axis; treat the unseen action only as contextual suggestion
elements.limitation: The original claim that all-ages work is more erotic is an opinion; occlusion never proves the hidden action or the work's rating.
elements.design_inference: Context and amodal completion support suggestion, so the plan labels it suggestion rather than an invisible event fact.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use lightweight dolphin-hem running shorts with an elastic waistband, a rounded hem rising at each outer thigh, a short side notch, and continuous contrast piping that follows the curved edge without turning the garment into fitted hotpants
elements.limitation: The Dolfin company name does not prove that every dolphin-hem short is that brand, and the name is not evidence of an animal-derived shape.
elements.design_inference: Construction terms replace a brand or meme label in the visible prompt.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Show a close-fitting thermal rib-knit bodysuit as one continuous garment from a high neck through the torso to two leg openings, with no separate shirt hem and with a small crotch closure seam visible in a product-legible full-body view
elements.limitation: A tucked top cannot be distinguished when the crotch and leg openings are hidden; thermal performance and HEATTECH branding are not pixel evidence.
elements.design_inference: The visible candidate uses the generic garment construction while retaining brand history only in provenance.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Show one caregiver responding to one visible need: the recipient has rain-soaked sleeves and tired hands, the caregiver wraps a dry towel around the shoulders and transfers a warm cup, and the recipient's receiving hand plus settled posture shows a concrete care result
elements.limitation: An apron, a soft smile, body size, or apparent age alone cannot establish caregiving, kinship, motherhood, or a recipient's inner comfort.
elements.design_inference: Need-action-result structure makes care observable without claiming a family role.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Build an interactive static substrate with one isolated target region crossing a translucent alternating high-and-low-contrast grid, keep the surrounding contours stable, and attach an external instruction to shake the display vertically; do not claim motion from the still image alone
elements.limitation: Static pixels cannot qualify the motion effect; display movement, color, device and observer can change the perception.
elements.design_inference: The output mode is optical interaction, not a conventional single rendered-frame success claim.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Show one drink cup stably supported against the upper torso with a visible contact shadow, a level liquid surface, one straw reaching the mouth, and both hands fully visible and separated from the cup so the hands-free relation is legible
elements.limitation: A cropped hand or missing contact shadow can make the cup appear suspended or supported off-frame.
elements.design_inference: The challenge is represented as a closed support-and-contact geometry rather than a tag.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a neutral frontal standing pose with both feet touching or nearly touching and show one continuous patch of background as medial-thigh negative space while preserving two complete thighs, knees, lower legs, and feet without silhouette deletion
elements.limitation: The gap cannot establish health, weight, body fat, exercise, gender, value, or a universal beauty ideal.
elements.design_inference: Feet-together geometry prevents an ordinary wide stance from being mislabeled as the element.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Show partial entrapment in saturated granular material: a collapsed depression with a cracked thin crust, radially displaced wet grains, braced arms pressing on the surface, and a clear waist-level submersion line rather than complete cinematic engulfment
elements.limitation: One frame proves entrapment but not continued sinking; complete below-surface engulfment is a fantasy departure from the cited experiment.
elements.design_inference: The default keeps the recognizable peril while preserving the measured partial-entrapment boundary.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Raise one arm in a three-quarter torso view and keep the shoulder chain continuous, showing the shallow axilla hollow between a rounded anterior fold and a thicker posterior fold without letting hair or clothing cover the region
elements.limitation: Axilla shape, folds, color, hair or sweat cannot establish hygiene, health, body weight, age or gender.
elements.design_inference: A three-quarter raised-arm view makes anatomy legible without turning the body region into a character trait.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use two separate footed thigh stockings with two visible top bands, a narrow skin gap between each band and the torso garment, and continuous fabric to both covered toes; if self-supporting, show a wider hold-up band instead of inventing hidden garter straps
elements.limitation: Waist-to-toe pantyhose, footless tights, leggings and stockings are different constructions even when colloquial Korean uses one label.
elements.design_inference: The default chooses hold-ups so the support relation remains visible without adding an unseen garter.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Place a school committee member at a school gate with a clearly readable committee armband, a clipboard checklist, and one concrete service action: checking a visible school badge and returning it to the arriving student after the check
elements.limitation: The role does not imply police authority, punishment powers, gender, grades, romance, personality or a universal armband practice.
elements.design_inference: A concrete school-service task makes the role legible without importing the blog's gap-personality narrative.

elements.prompt_clause_en: In a close three-quarter adult-character portrait, show one fingertip crossing the lip boundary, a gentle lip seal around the finger pad, and an intact wrist-to-hand-to-finger depth chain; keep the contact distinct from a vertical shushing finger or nail biting
evidence_groups_en: distinct from a vertical shushing finger
elements.limitation: A still image cannot establish a repetitive habit, anxiety, regression, trauma, diagnosis, or sexual intent.
elements.design_inference: The element is compiled as one visible self-contact action; explicit adult identity remains owned by the ordinary scene contract.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Construct a classic bunny costume with tall paired rabbit ears, a structured strapless satin one-piece with a high-cut leg line, a detached white collar and dark bow tie, detached white cuffs, sheer tights, pumps, and a small centered tail visible in a three-quarter view
elements.limitation: Rabbit ears plus a generic leotard do not prove the historical uniform grammar, and the generalized anime costume is broader than one branded uniform.
elements.design_inference: The clause uses museum-backed garment construction without asking for a protected logo or readable brand mark.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a three-stage fictional transformation sequence with the same continuing identity marker before, during, and after the change, one explicit magical or technological catalyst, a visible transformation boundary, and an aftermath action of recognizing the changed embodiment
elements.limitation: A static gender-bent design, cross-dressing, and real transgender identity do not establish this fictional transformation genre; direction, consent and permanence require explicit narrative input.
elements.design_inference: The default uses a transformation process rather than collapsing body swap, possession and reincarnation into one ambiguous image.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a paired affection-and-control sequence: repeat the same love-target token, first show an ordinary caring exchange, then show the same admirer using a visible surveillance board and blocked exit to control that specific target, with the target's changed reaction as consequence
elements.limitation: A weapon, blood, dark eyes or one threatening expression does not establish love motivation, repeated obsession, duration, or a mental-health diagnosis.
elements.design_inference: Paired action states bind affection to later control without turning the term into a facial preset.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Fit one coherent pair of glasses to the face with two aligned lens rims, one bridge resting on the nose, and two temples continuing toward the ears; keep lens reflections weak enough to preserve the selected eye expression
elements.limitation: Glasses do not establish intelligence, reliability, shyness, profession, personality or degree of visual impairment.
elements.design_inference: The accessory is defined by attachment and perspective rather than a personality stereotype.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Show scalp hair converging into one visible tie point, with one continuous ponytail bundle beginning behind that tie, widening under fiber curvature and gravity, then tapering naturally; if the head turns, give the bundle a small delayed motion arc
evidence_groups_en: converging into one visible tie point
elements.limitation: A ponytail does not establish gender, age, athletic status, liveliness, obedience, or ethnicity.
elements.design_inference: Bundle physics supplies visual continuity while cultural personality readings remain nonclaims.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Direct one cold dismissal at one visible target using a target-locked gaze, a slightly raised chin, one asymmetric tightened lip corner, a dismissive hand turn, and the target's visible withdrawal; label it a contempt display rather than proving exact spoken abuse without text
elements.limitation: A low camera, one lip corner, or a face without a target cannot prove contempt, dominance, exact dialogue or a stable relationship.
elements.design_inference: The no-text default represents directed visible dismissal while reserving exact verbal abuse for formats that explicitly support readable dialogue.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Keep the lower rib cage, waist, and pelvis as one continuous abdomen surface, place one navel on the center line, and let the soft tissue respond visibly to the chosen stretch or twist without forcing a six-pack or an idealized waist ratio
elements.limitation: Flatness, softness, folds or muscle definition cannot establish health, body fat, pregnancy, diet, exercise, age or value.
elements.design_inference: The body region is expressed as anatomy responding to pose, not as a normative physique preset.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Build a coherent mirror selfie with one explicit mirror boundary, the reflected phone covering the face, a direct hand occluder and a separately reflected hand occluder covering distinct points, consistent left-right handedness, and clear T-junctions at every occlusion
elements.limitation: The named 2016 Chinese trend and first creator were not independently corroborated; the executable claim is limited to reflection and occlusion geometry.
elements.design_inference: Exact handedness and T-junction checks separate a possible mirror pose from impossible strategic covering.

elements.prompt_clause_en: Use a close facial composition combining misaligned rolled eyes, displaced small pupils, a slack open mouth, a protruding tongue, visible drool or tears, flush, and facial asymmetry; treat double peace signs as optional and do not infer the cause or relationship from the expression
elements.limitation: The expression alone cannot establish cause, consent, prior state, relationship, duration, or a person's inner condition.
elements.design_inference: The record requires a cluster of visible manga-expression signals instead of using the culture label as evidence.
